WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: FOOD ADVERTISEMENT

This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Food Advertisement helps you succeed in HYGIENE AND NUTRITION ACTIVITIES. You will understand it, practise it, and use it in your school compound, home, farm, or county.
